title: Ice-Tipped Arrows Guide — Empowered Attacks, Ice Fragments and Frenzy Charges
summary: Ice-Tipped Arrows is a buff that empowers your next few Bow or Projectile Spear attacks: it converts their physical damage to cold and makes hits spawn Ice Fragments that explode. This guide explains how the empowerment count is spent, why Twister can be empowered, how Barrage repeats interact with it, how a Frenzy Charge bypasses its cooldown, the Weapon Set rule that breaks it, and why old 8-second / 3-fragment numbers are outdated after 0.4.
description: Ice-Tipped Arrows deep guide: empowerment count and invalid skills, Twister and Ice Shot synergy, Ice Fragment spawning and delayed explosion, physical-to-cold conversion, Frenzy Charge cooldown bypass, Weapon Set consistency rule, combo with Barrage, mapping and bossing rotations, troubleshooting and community evidence.

sections.title: Quick Answer: It Empowers Your Next Few Attacks
paragraphs: Ice-Tipped Arrows is a buff, not a damage skill. Casting it empowers your next few valid Bow or Projectile Spear attacks: those attacks deal physical converted to cold and spawn Ice Fragments on hit.
The empowerment is spent per attack, the buff has a cooldown, and a Frenzy Charge can bypass that cooldown. It cannot empower sustained (channeled) skills.

sections.title: Requirements and Valid Skills
paragraphs: You need a bow or projectile spear equipped, and the empowered skill must be a valid repeatable attack on that weapon. Twister (spear) and Ice Shot (bow) are the headline valid skills.
Sustained / channeled skills are explicitly excluded — they cannot be empowered, which is why some channeled bow skills show no fragments.

sections.title: Empowered Attacks
paragraphs: Each cast empowers a fixed number of following valid attacks. The count is spent one attack at a time; when it hits zero the cold conversion and fragment spawning stop until you recast (or bypass the cooldown with a Frenzy Charge).

Empowerment applies to the whole attack, so multi-hit attacks still count as one empowered use. Twister is empowered because it is a repeatable spear attack, which is why Ice-Tipped Arrows is core to Twister builds.

sections.title: Skill Interactions
paragraphs: Twister: the empowered Twister converts its physical damage to cold and drops Ice Fragments around every enemy it hits. Because Twister can re-hit the same enemy on a timer, one empowered cast can drop fragments many times.
Ice Shot: empowered Ice Shot gains extra cold and fragments on top of its own shatter; keep the two cold sources distinct when reading damage.

Barrage: Barrage repeats an empowered skill. Whether each repeat consumes a separate empowerment is a current-client detail — verify on 0.5.4 rather than assuming. On the Twister combo, one Ice-Tipped cast typically empowers the whole Barrage-volley of Twisters in testing, but confirm per patch.

sections.title: Mechanics: Ice Fragments and Conversion
paragraphs: Empowered attacks convert their physical damage to cold, so any flat physical on the weapon and gear feeds the cold output. On hit they also spawn Ice Fragments in a small radius around the target.
Fragments explode after a short delay, dealing cold AoE. The delay means fragments are a layered AoE, not instant — positioning and density still matter for the full payoff.
The conversion is the main scaling lever: flat physical and cold modifiers both apply, while attack speed mostly controls how fast you spend the empowerment window.
bullets: Hits spawn Ice Fragments in a radius.
Fragments detonate after a short delay (layered AoE).
Flat physical and cold both scale the output.

sections.title: Frenzy Charge Cooldown Bypass
paragraphs: Ice-Tipped Arrows has a cooldown between casts. Spending a Frenzy Charge bypasses that cooldown, letting you re-empower sooner — it does not add extra empowered uses beyond the fixed count.

Without a Frenzy Charge source the loop is a cooldown cycle: cast, spend the empowerments, wait, recast. Combat Frenzy (freeze / electrocute / pin) is the usual charge source that keeps the buff nearly permanent.

sections.title: Weapon Set Consistency
paragraphs: The empowerment only applies to attacks on the same weapon set that carries Ice-Tipped Arrows. If your main attack is on Weapon Set 2 but Ice-Tipped Arrows is on Set 1, the attack shows as enabled but produces no fragments.
This mismatch is the most common 'enabled but no fragments' report. Keep Ice-Tipped Arrows and the attack you want to empower on the same set.

sections.title: Mapping Rotation
paragraphs: Refresh Ice-Tipped Arrows whenever it is available (or whenever you have a Frenzy Charge to bypass the cooldown) so packs are permanently converted to cold and shatter off-screen via Herald of Ice.
In Twister builds the loop is: keep Ice-Tipped up, spin Whirling Slash, then Twister through packs. The fragments plus Herald shatter clear multiple screens.

sections.title: Where It Is Used
paragraphs: Ice-Tipped Arrows is core to Twister Spirit Walker, Ice-Tipped Twisters Amazon, and many Glacial Lance / projectile spear builds. It is the cold-conversion engine that lets those builds freeze and shatter.
Some Deadeye bow builds borrow it as a cold layer on Ice Shot or Lightning Arrow. Its value is the reliable freeze and fragment AoE, not direct damage.

Ice-Tipped Twisters Amazon: campaign speedrun enabler.
Glacial Lance / spear builds: cold fragments for freeze.

sections.title: Community Evidence
paragraphs: Two misunderstandings dominate community posts: players think Barrage repeats each consume a separate empowerment (unconfirmed per patch — verify on client), and players copy old 0.4 guides quoting an 8-second buff and 3 fragments, which changed in 0.4.
The 'enabled but no fragments' case is almost always a Weapon Set split, confirmed by replicating the setup on client 0.5.4 with the buff and attack on one set.
